head: 9b513f22b3106175052d9072bbdeded84cc68e16
mode_notes: M4 fix round 3 (Kiro): monitor-delivery requeue via SessionStart/SessionEnd, stale-doc refresh, build smoke test. wb verify PASS. Next: the human's live two-session test closes M4.
autonomous_decisions: [autonomous] 2026-11-07: GLM-5.3-Flash free and DeepSeek/MiMo free hit OpenCode's free usage limit mid-M2 (GLM resets in ~9.7 h). M2 continued in the same OpenCode session on opencode/nemotron-3.5-super-vl-free, the free model that still answered, instead of waiting or paying. Reversible: all work is in git. (Re-added by Claude: the builder's state rewrite dropped it.)

[autonomous] 2026-11-07: The M4 plugin-loading fix is held until the round-1 reviewer finishes, so the reviewer reads a stable tree; then plugin loading and the review findings go to the builder as one fix.

[autonomous] 2026-11-07: The M4 round-2 fixes proceed without waiting for the npm-name decision, because the fix (installed commands call this repo's CLI by absolute path, written at setup time) is name-independent. Only the published npm name (M12) stays a blocker for the human.

Name decided by the human (2026-11-07): the npm package and CLI command are `mcp-parley` (Claude advised against it as a word-swap of the unrelated `parley-mcp` package; the human chose it anyway). [autonomous] follow-ons: data dir becomes ~/.mcp-parley, plugin/marketplace names use mcp-parley, the repo folder and GitHub repo stay `parley-mcp` (renaming the GitHub repo is an outward action for the human).

[autonomous] 2026-11-07 (Claude): instead of adding tsx (not an allowed dependency), added a `build` script (tsc -p tsconfig.build.json -> dist/). cliEntryPath already prefers dist/cli/bin.js, so a launcher written by setup run from dist/ uses plain node. Running setup from the .ts source still writes a tsx launcher (a known limitation; the live-test steps use the build). Found and fixed while building: src/mcp/server.ts imported SDK subpaths without .js, which works under Vitest but crashes real Node; guarded by test/cli/build-imports.test.ts.

[autonomous] 2026-11-07: Review round 3 passed (7/10) but found monitor deliveries are never requeued (high). Fixing it, and the stale docs, before the human's live test, so the test can cover requeue too; not a new review round, since the verdict was pass.
summary: M4 after fix round 3 (Kiro): monitor deliveries are now requeued through the real hook path (SessionStart source=startup requeues this agent's stale delivered-unread messages; SessionEnd also requeues this agent's monitor-* deliveries, which a Claude-session-keyed SessionEnd could never match). Replaced the misleading test that called requeueDeliveredToSession('monitor-7') directly with tests that drive runHookSessionEnd/runHookSessionStart using realistic Claude session ids. Refreshed stale docs (harness-notes launcher-needs-tsx -> runs compiled dist/ via plain node; PROGRESS live-test step 7 thread-id source + a new requeue-on-close step). Added a build smoke test (tsc -p tsconfig.build.json into a dist/ subdir, run node .../cli/bin.js --help, skip if tsc missing). wb verify PASS, pnpm check exit=0.
open_risks: blocker: GitHub Actions blocked by the account billing lock (human-only fix).
next_action: M4 fix round 3 is done (monitor requeue, stale docs, build smoke test; wb verify PASS). Give the human the live two-session Claude Code test (docs/PROGRESS.md, steps start with pnpm build) — now including step 8, which closes an unread reader session and checks the message requeues to sent. M4 closes only after the live test passes. Pushing/publishing is the human's call.
